links.outcome: Clinical acceptability of AI auto-contours on visual review, and accuracy versus expert manual contours
links.effect: Mean DSC 0.79 ± 0.19, HD95 6.35 ± 12.2 mm; 93.5% (315/337) of contours acceptable, so about 6.5% failed; lower performance in small and low-contrast structures and atypical cases.
links.quote: However, performance variability in atypical cases underscores the necessity of rigorous visual verification by experts for clinical implementation.

screen.reason: Retrospective evaluation of a deep learning-based auto-segmentation tool (RatoGuide) for radiotherapy contouring across typical and atypical clinical cases evaluated by expert reviewers.
